Name: Customize Trinkets
Author: Dragoon23
Description:
[size=3][b]Customize Trinkets[/b]

Options: Everything is configurable. [b]
[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Anvil cost and cooldown.[/size]
[*][size=3][size=3]Golden Spur duration.[/size][/size]
[*][size=3][size=3][size=3]Frog Egg appearance and cooldown. [/size][/size][/size]
[*][size=3]Parrot Egg appearance and level.[/size]
[*][size=3]Fairy Box appearance and level.[/size]
[*][size=3]Ice Rod type, duration, and frequency.[/size]
[*][size=3]Magic Quiver type, duration, frequency.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[/size][size=3]With the exception of Frog cooldown, all options follow vanilla ranges. [/size]
[size=3]
Due to the way the game code is designed, Parrot/Fairy appearance and Frog Cooldown can be changed without Anvil and at anytime. Appearance changes require reequipping the trinket.
[/size]
[size=3]Can choose via the config file or GMCM config UI.
[/size]
[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=3][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url]. [/size]
[*][size=3]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].[/size]
[*][size=3]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
(Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM [/url]﻿to use the config UI. Highly recommended. [/size]

[size=5]How to use[/size]
[size=3]Config file is generated after first launch. Default is everything is off and vanilla behavior. Enter/Choose which option you want to use and save.  Alternatively, use the GMCM config UI. [/size]
[size=3]
